reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key mechanistic premises. E4 mentions lattice distortion from atomic-size mismatch in HEAs generally, but no evidence quantifies Al-induced distortion in this system, links it to activation barriers, or connects it to phase stability and cryogenic twinning. E3 shows twinning at 77 K in a different alloy, not linked to Al or lattice distortion. E1 and E2 are irrelevant to the mechanism.
premises: Al induces significant lattice distortion in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni HEAs
Lattice distortion raises the activation barrier for phase transformations and defect migration
Enhanced lattice distortion stabilizes the single FCC phase under high-temperature and irradiation
